description: Calculate the liquidation price for an isolated-margin futures position with one flat maintenance margin rate (mmr, which you supply from your exchange's tier). It is a generic flat-rate model, for linear and inverse alike, not any one exchange's engine: no tiered maintenance amounts, no liquidation fee, no cross-margin (shared collateral) logic, so it does not apply to cross-margin accounts and can differ from an exchange's own figure. Use when user asks "where will I get liquidated?" or "how close is my liq price?". Returns: liquidationPrice, distancePct (how far from entry).

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined (e.g. Deribit/Bybit/MEXC BTC-settled perps).
